India Post Revenue Surpasses ₹4,000 Crore for Two Quarters

India Post has achieved a revenue exceeding ₹4,000 crore for two consecutive quarters for the first time. In the first half of FY27, its revenue rose by 24 percent to ₹8,212.7 crore, with the parcel business experiencing a 71 percent growth. This financial performance was announced by Minister Scindia.
